1.005 to 1.00. Scale the epsilon correction with the magnitude so exact
half-cent ties round up, matching the test accounting added.

Merge it: main goes green, half-up invoicing takes effect.
Keep old rounding: I delete accounting\u0027s test instead and CI goes green with 1.005 billing as 1.00.' \
  --option 'Merge it' --recommended \
  --option 'Keep old rounding' \
  --waiting
